Your appointment destination

What to know before visiting from Missouri Avenue Corridor.

Appointments from Missouri Avenue Corridor take place at 6022 N 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85016. Call 602-607-5686 if you need help selecting a service or planning a group visit. The salon is open Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–7 PM and Sunday 10 AM–5 PM; available booking times may end earlier. Free on-site parking is available. Check the current menu and booking flow for service choices and starting prices.

View current menu →

Plan your visit · Manicure / Gel Manicure

Choose regular polish, gel, or structure before the short east-west trip.

A Missouri Avenue guest should book a manicure according to what is already on the nails and what the new finish must do. Regular polish avoids lamp curing and follows its own wear pattern; gel cures quickly and has a different removal cycle. Neither category automatically covers acrylic, dip, Builder Gel, or Gel-X removal. If the nail needs added structure, length, a fill, or repairs, choose the appropriate enhancement path instead of a basic manicure.

Compare nail services →

Another option · Spa Pedicures

Pedicure levels differ by more than polish.

Compare care steps, massage, specialty products, and time. Organic Spa is the featured 50-minute everyday spa option, while longer rituals serve a more extended treatment goal.

Builder Gel is considered when support—not only color—is needed.
